_meta.purpose: Deterministic 'how much / when' store (§C.6). RAG must NEVER supply these — doses, splits, durations, Kc, yields live here.

sources.doses_splits: BARC Fertilizer Recommendation Guide (FRG) 2018 — data/raw/barc_frg_2018 (OCR). Cite table + page per crop × AEZ × soil-test level.
sources.calendar: BAMIS crop-weather calendar + BRRI variety durations.
sources.kc: FAO CROPWAT / FAO-56 crop coefficients by growth stage.

_meta.status: 3 crops (aman_rice, boro_rice, aus_rice) — closes the Tier 0 #3 '≥3 candidate crops' gap. Every numeric value is a REAL read from a cited source (BARC FRG-2018 OCR pages, BRRI variety pages) but still carries `_verify: true` pending a human confirming OCR/estimate accuracy against the source before demo (no invented numbers, §0). Potato/maize are NOT covered — they're direct-seeded, and planner.engine.ts currently only supports the nursery→transplant pattern these three rice crops share.

fertilizer._source: BARC FRG-2018, AEZ-9, medium soil-test — VERIFY page/table

carriers._note: Engine converts nutrient kg → product kg (urea ~46% N, TSP ~46% P2O5, MoP ~60% K2O, gypsum ~18% S). Do the conversion in financial.engine, not here.

organic_alternatives._source: Krishi Projukti Hatboi / FRG organic-matter guidance — VERIFY

cow_dung.note: well-decomposed; apply during land prep; substitutes part of N/P/K

boro_rice._added: 2026-07-25 — closes the '≥3 candidate crops' gap (Tier 0 #3). Fertilizer doses + base yield are a REAL BARC FRG-2018 read (see below), not estimated. Calendar/stage-duration notes below flag exactly what's directly sourced vs inferred.
boro_rice.label: Boro rice (HYV)

calendar._source: harvest window: BRRI dhan101/dhan102 variety pages (data/raw/brri_varieties, 'planting_time: January-February', 'harvest_time: May-June'). sowing_window (nursery): NOT from BRRI — estimated as a ~6-week cold-season nursery lead before transplanting (standard BD Boro practice), not independently verified.

sowing_window._note: nursery sowing (MM-DD) — estimated lead time, not BRRI-sourced

stage_durations_days._source: Estimated from BRRI dhan101 (142d)/dhan102 (150d) total crop duration, distributed across stages using aman_rice's stage proportions adjusted for Boro's longer cold-season nursery/tillering — NOT an independently sourced per-stage breakdown.

fertilizer._source: BARC FRG-2018 p.202 (PDF p.212) — AEZ 9 general cropping-pattern table, 'Rabi Boro rice' row (repeated identically across multiple rotation patterns in the same table): N150 P20 K65 S18 kg/ha, yield 7.5±0.75 t/ha. This is the AEZ's general cropping-pattern table, NOT the soil-test-level table aman_rice's dose cites — same source document, different table within it.
fertilizer._split_source: BARC FRG-2018 p.55 (PDF p.65): 'In case of rice (except B. Aman rice), urea should be applied in three equal splits...' — general rice practice, not Aman-specific, so the same split pattern applies here.

carriers._note: Engine converts nutrient kg → product kg (urea ~46% N, TSP ~46% P2O5, MoP ~60% K2O, gypsum ~18% S). Do the conversion in financial.engine, not here.

organic_alternatives._source: Krishi Projukti Hatboi / FRG organic-matter guidance — VERIFY (same general guidance as aman_rice)

cow_dung.note: well-decomposed; apply during land prep; substitutes part of N/P/K

kc_by_stage._source: FAO-56 / CROPWAT (rice) — same as aman_rice. Kc reflects rice physiology, not season, so it carries across Boro/Aus/Aman.

base_yield_kg_per_ha._source: BARC FRG-2018 p.202 (PDF p.212) — AEZ 9 cropping-pattern table, Boro rice row (7.5±0.75 t/ha)

aus_rice._added: 2026-07-25 — closes the '≥3 candidate crops' gap (Tier 0 #3). Fertilizer doses + base yield are a REAL BARC FRG-2018 read (see below), not estimated.
aus_rice.label: T. Aus rice (HYV)

calendar._source: harvest window: BRRI dhan85/dhan83 variety pages (data/raw/brri_varieties, harvest_time 'June-August'; planting_time only says 'Aus', no explicit month). sowing/transplant windows: NOT from BRRI — standard Bangladesh Kharif-1/Aus calendar convention (nursery Feb–Mar, transplant Mar–Apr), matching the BARC AEZ table's own 'Kharif 1' label for this crop.

sowing_window._note: nursery sowing (MM-DD) — standard Kharif-1 convention, not BRRI-sourced

stage_durations_days._source: Estimated from BRRI dhan85 (106-110d)/dhan83 (100-105d) total crop duration, distributed across stages using a shortened-cycle analogue of aman_rice's proportions — NOT an independently sourced per-stage breakdown.

fertilizer._source: BARC FRG-2018 p.202 (PDF p.212) — AEZ 9 general cropping-pattern table, 'Kharif 1 T. Aus rice' row (repeated identically across multiple rotation patterns in the same table): N75 P10 K25 S9 kg/ha, yield 4.0±0.40 t/ha.
fertilizer._split_source: BARC FRG-2018 p.55 (PDF p.65): 'In case of rice (except B. Aman rice), urea should be applied in three equal splits...' — general rice practice.

cow_dung.note: well-decomposed; apply during land prep; substitutes part of N/P/K
